evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce a counterfactual evaluation framework that separates selected records (targets) from the applied change (an update).

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate the framework on two tasks: traffic assignment, where affected demand must be identified from road counts, and database repair, where affected rows must be identified from aggregate reports.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: In a component-reuse study, testing new target-update pairings from two proposals raises mean held-out recovery rate to 0.616, compared with 0.580 when selecting between the original proposals.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: For sparse-target actions in the traffic experiments, retaining the proposed update on reference targets achieves 79.4% of the reference loss reduction, compared with 43.7% from tuning update strength on the proposed targets.
